Set Workshop Targets by Period
Choose the reporting period, enter each workshop target, then the cards show completed / target and percentage completion.
Completion is counted from units marked Done in the Tracker whose Actual End date falls within the selected period. If Actual End is blank, the dashboard uses Plan End as the fallback completion date.
Excel Update and Export
Connect Live Excel to keep the scoreboard in sync with your workbook — it re-reads the Tracker sheet every few seconds whenever you save. Or click here / drop a file for a one-time refresh. (Live sync needs Chrome or Edge.)
